verdict.rationale: GitLab's site states that customers can make one annual commitment and steer spend across seat-based licenses and usage-based credits without re-procurement, which matches the story directly. The only support is a single marketing-page line, with no documentation of how the allocation works. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the commitment and credit-allocation mechanics (allocation controls, limits, admin workflow), independent or hands-on corroboration.
